selectInstallToOpen: Select Install in Slack to open the installation page.
selectInstallToReopen: Select Install in Slack to reopen the installation page.
checkedNoApp: I checked Slack and no app was created. Create a new app.
getToken: Get your App configuration access token
step2: Select the workspace where you want to install your bot.
tokenUse: Paperclip uses this token to create your app
creating: Creating your Slack app. You can return to this saved setup.
approveInstallation: Approve installation with your Slack account. Paperclip will link it to your signed-in Paperclip account and send you a welcome DM.
credentialsSaved: Your installation credentials are saved. Retry connecting to finish setup. If Slack access has changed, authorize the same app again.
